search_window.basis: Window begins at verified completion of preceding hourly watch and ends at current observation. Newly discovered reporting is distinguished from event time; older reports and duplicates excluded.

findings.title: Two Palestinians killed, several injured in Israeli airstrike west of Gaza City
findings.location: Al-Katiba area, west of Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: WAFA reports two Palestinian civilians killed and several others injured when an Israeli airstrike hit a vehicle; exact number of injuries, identities, medical verification and further damage unconfirmed
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Local sources said Israeli warplanes struck a vehicle in the area, killing two civilians and injuring several others, according to a preliminary toll.
findings.source_type: Palestinian national news agency attributing preliminary casualty account to local sources; no independent medical or second-outlet confirmation in this bounded watch

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Direct WAFA English latest-news index after official-first checks and 12 targeted searches, followed by direct read of canonical article
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Article published 23 Nov at 16:11 local Gaza time (06:11 PST), after preceding watch completed 05:51:59 PST. Vehicle strike in Al-Katiba not recorded in preceding authenticated heartbeat.
bounded_discovery_context.publication_relative_to_prior_watch: Published about 19 minutes after preceding watch completion; strike's actual clock time not independently established
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration: Only WAFA preliminary local-source account verified in this pass; no independent medical confirmation or Israeli response verified
bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Distinct named Al-Katiba vehicle location and two-death preliminary tally from prior Jabalia UNRWA water-well worker strike, Jabalia mosque injuries, Khan Younis foot injury, Bureij woman injury, and Gaza medical-source 24-hour aggregate. Potential overlap with other city vehicle strikes cannot be ruled out; do not sum to hospital aggregate without verification.
bounded_discovery_context.caution: WAFA says two civilians killed and several injured; victim status, exact count, and responsibility have not been independently corroborated. Source time is publication, not verified event time.
